 Aadarsha Kutumbam OTT release and platform details: When and where to watch Venkatesh Daggubati, Srinidhi Shetty's Telugu action comedy movie online after its theatrical run
 SECTIONS Aadarsha Kutumbam OTT release and platform details: When and where to watch Venkatesh Daggubati, Srinidhi Shetty's Telugu action comedy movie online after its theatrical run By ET Entertainment Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Oct 30, 2026, 11:12:00 AM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47 – AK 47 marks the reunion of Venkatesh Daggubati and Trivikram Srinivas. This film recently premiered in theatres and has received positive reviews from audiences. An OTT platform has already secured the digital streaming rights for the film, which will be available post theatrical release. Read on to know where to watch the film after its theatrical run.
 Aadarsha Kutumbam hit the theatres on October 30 (Credit: Instagram)
 Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47 – AK 47 marks the reunion of Venkatesh Daggubati and filmmaker Trivikram Srinivas. Venkatesh plays Chittibabu, while Srinidhi Shetty essays the female lead and his wife in the film. The film arrived in theatres on October 30 and opened to positive reviews. Now, there is an update regarding its digital release.
 Aadarsha Kutumbam OTT release details
Netflix has acquired the digital streaming rights to Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47 – AK 47. The film will premiere on the streaming platform after completing its theatrical run. However, viewers will have to wait for the makers to announce the exact date of its digital release.
— Netflix_INSouth (@Netflix_INSouth) 
The streaming platform had included the film in its annual Telugu film campaign, Netflix Pandaga 2026, announced earlier this year. The campaign featured several upcoming Telugu titles, with Aadarsha Kutumbam among the films confirmed for a digital release.
 You Might Also Like: Jailer 2 box office collection day 15: Rajinikanth's film beats Coolie, enters Rs 500 crore club in India
 Netflix also confirmed that the movie will be available in five languages: Telugu, Tamil, Hindi, Malayalam and Kannada. Announcing the acquisition, the platform described the collaboration between Trivikram and Venkatesh as a meeting of class and mass at House No. 47. It also confirmed that the film would arrive on the service after its theatrical release.
 While the streaming rights have been secured, the OTT premiere date remains unannounced. The makers are expected to decide on the release window based on the film's box office performance. Until then, audiences can catch the movie in cinemas.
 More about Aadarsha Kutumbam 
The film brings Venkatesh and Trivikram together again after their earlier collaborations, Nuvvu Naaku Nachav and Malliswari. Their reunion has also brought back memories of how the actor supported the filmmaker during the early stages of his career.
Trivikram recently recalled that his writing journey had begun with Venkatesh's Pavitra Bandham. He also spoke about the encouragement he received from the actor during the making of Pelli Chesukundam, even though the two barely knew each other at the time.
 You Might Also Like: Aadarsha Kutumbam Twitter review: 7 tweets you must read before watching Venkatesh Daggubati, Srinidhi Shetty's Telugu action comedy movie
The filmmaker further told The Hindu, "When I narrated the story of Nuvvu Naaku Nachav, I still do not know what gave him so much faith in me. As soon as I finished narrating it, he shook hands with producer Ravi Kishore garu and director K. Vijaya Bhaskar garu and told them that we were going ahead with the film. That moment changed the course of my career. I will always remain grateful to him."
 Aadarsha Kutumbam cast and crew details
In Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47 – AK 47, Venkatesh plays Chittibabu, while Srinidhi Shetty portrays his wife. The film also features Nara Rohith, Nivetha Pethuraj , Yuvina Parthavi, Raj Prajwal, Rao Ramesh, Satya, Brahmaji, Vennela Kishore and Raghu Babu in important roles.
Trivikram Srinivas has written and directed the film. It is produced by S. Radha Krishna under the banner of Haarika & Hassine Creations. Thaman S has composed the music, while Ravi K. Chandran is the cinematographer. Navin Nooli has handled the editing, and A.S. Prakash is the production designer.
With its theatrical run now underway, the film's box office performance will play a role in determining when it makes its digital debut.
